capabilities: Commit and push edits automatically seconds after typing stops
Pull remote changes on a 30-second interval and on app focus
Merge conflicting edits with in-note conflict markers and a resolve flow
Sync on mobile using a built-in JavaScript git engine
Show sync state and conflicts in the status bar
disambiguation: Not a git history or backup tool; it has no per-note restore UI and exists to sync the vault across devices.
extras: Still unpublished; recommended install path is via BRAT as a beta plugin. On Obsidian versions older than 1.11.4 the token is stored in plain text in data.json. Files over 100 MB are never synced.
intentEvidence: Keeps your vault in sync across devices through a git repository, the way Obsidian Sync does
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault synced across devices through a git repository without manual commits and pushes.

relations.evidence: through a git repository, the way Obsidian Sync does

summary: Git-based vault sync that automatically commits, pushes and pulls notes across devices, including mobile, working like Obsidian Sync.
